about_the_game:
◆Story◆


As an apprentice witch, she wants to be accepted by the Witches' Guild and achieve something, so she decides to recreate the legendary Lost Magic.
But the book only contains part of the content, and I don't know how to reproduce it with these materials, so I can only try to mix it again and again, and every time I mix it, I grow up and gradually discover the secrets of myself and the important people around me.

There are many obstacles to overcome in order to achieve your goals and ideals.
But... you are not alone... you are surrounded by family and partners who support you.

◆Game Content◆

-Collecting materials-


You can collect different materials in many scenes.
It's not just the scene that affects the type of materials you can collect.
The time of day and the seasons will bring you fantastic materials you never knew existed.

-Magic Blending-


To recreate the lost magic, you need to add the ingredients from the mixing bowl.
However, you don't know which ingredients are needed to make the magic, so you'll have to keep trying to find the answer.
However, there will be accidents in the process of trial and error.
You may encounter an explosion in the mixing room that causes material loss or summons strange creatures.
The smoke from the explosion may also attract bandits with bad intentions.
And, of course, there are all sorts of magical creatures that can be accidentally summoned.

-Experiment Diary-


Sometimes the mixing experiments are not all accidents.
There are also cases where you can mix up the props.
There are more than 20 types of mixtures to explore.
Of course, each mixture has more than one recipe.
With over 100 blends in total to keep you on your toes.
Even if you haven't reached your goal yet, you can still start your own experimentation journal.

-The Chain of Magic-


The Chain of Magic allows you to strengthen your various abilities.
From collecting, to blending, to delegating,
Failure is accompanied by growth, and growth makes it easier to pursue your goals.

-Mirror of Memory-


The Mirror of Memory allows you to explore the past memories of important people.
Learn about their past and experience the future together once you understand it.

-A Monster Farm-


Do you think that accidentally summoned magical creatures are useless?
No, of course you can tame them with your own magic.
Not only that, but you can also cultivate and strengthen their abilities.
And they will help you on your way to the Harmonisation Experiment.

-The Adventurers' Guild-


The Adventurers' Guild is closely associated with the Witchcraft and Wizardry Society.
Of course, you will be able to enjoy the benefits of the Adventurer's Guild.
As well as buying the blends you want to sell, the association will also sell imported materials that cannot be sourced.
You can also check the Commission Bulletin Board to see if anyone needs help.
Offer what you can and get paid for it.

-Lust value-


Where there is light, there is shadow.
If you follow a special path, you can make money in a different way.
As you follow that path, you may come across some special processes.



◆Game Features◆


♥In addition to the main characters, there are also endings that belong to important characters.
♥Be prepared for an unexpected and special ending, and the unexpected is, of course, fraught with danger.Please be prepared at all times.
♥120,000 words of text content,Travel and learn about the world of fantasy.
♥Rich game content, varied but not complicated, easy to experience the other world.
♥All kinds of sexual interests are available to satisfy the xenogenic interests in you.
♥With over 20 CGs, it's like taking part in a visual feast.
♥A truly functional dress-up system is more than just a costume change.
♥The female protagonist is dubbed in Japanese.

This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work . The game contains Nudity or Sexual Content, sexual assault, non-consensual sex, General Mature Content or BDSM.
